title: Topology selector, processBlock wiring, crossfade, CMakeLists
description:
Be the sole PluginProcessor + CMakeLists.txt owner for phase F. Wire CrossoverSplitter, MultibandGate, and HissCurtain into prepare/process with a spectral topology selector and state-safe topology crossfade; register new sources and MultibandGateTests.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp existing phase E signal order (key → delay → detector → guards → state → gain)
- Source/DSP/CrossoverSplitter.*, MultibandGate.*, HissCurtain.* public APIs from f.1–f.3
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §2.2 topologies, §3 signal flow Spectral Split stage, §14–16, and §28-ish param smoothing note: mode/topology changes use state-safe crossfade ~5–30 ms
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for global.topology, crossover, hissCurtain.*, per-band controls
- Existing CMakeLists.txt target_sources / test registration patterns from prior phases

PluginProcessor wiring (realtime-safe):
- Members: CrossoverSplitter, MultibandGate, HissCurtain plus any small crossfade/dry wet helpers. Preallocate temp band/dry buffers in prepare only.
- Topology selector (Full Band / Dual Band / Tri Band / Hiss Curtain):
  - Full Band: bypass splitter; single-band MultibandGate or existing broadband gain path with MultibandGate numBands=1
  - Dual: TwoWay splitter + MultibandGate 2 bands
  - Tri: ThreeWay splitter + MultibandGate 3 bands
  - Hiss Curtain: activate HissCurtain on the (post-gain or pre-gain) main path; document order relative to broadband gate — prefer apply curtain on open/sustaining audio after main gain law or as the spectral stage’s replacement path
- processBlock conceptual spectral stage after existing detector/state-derived targets are available:
  1) Read topology + crossover + per-band floor/tau + hiss curtain params from APVTS (ParameterIDs) or safe defaults
  2) Split if Dual/Tri; compute/apply MultibandGate targets (from existing envelope/threshold path and per-band offsets if present; else flattarget from current broadband gate gain distributed/adjusted)
  3) HissCurtain path when selected: feed SNR_H from high-band or detector HF metric if available, else broadband envelope residual heuristic documented in code
  4) Topology changes: equal-power or linear crossfade 5–30 ms between previous and new topology outputs so transitions do not click (risk_notes). Never hard-switch mid-block without fade.
- prepareToPlay: prepare splitter/gate/curtain and fade buffers at SR/maxBlock/channel count. reset() clears filter and fade state.
- No editor/GUI work. No reimplementation of LR4/TPT/gain-math beyond calling unit APIs.

CMakeLists.txt (phase-F sole owner):
- Add CrossoverSplitter.cpp, MultibandGate.cpp, HissCurtain.cpp to plugin/library target_sources
- Register tests/MultibandGateTests.cpp on the existing test executable/target (body filled in f.5)
- Additive only — do not restructure unrelated targets

Do NOT implement test bodies (f.5). Do NOT rewrite DSP unit sources owned by f.1–f.3.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp construct and prepare CrossoverSplitter, MultibandGate, and HissCurtain
processBlock topology selector supports Full Band, Dual Band, Tri Band, and Hiss Curtain paths
Full Band bypasses spectral split; Dual/Tri engage CrossoverSplitter + MultibandGate; Hiss Curtain engages HissCurtain
Topology changes crossfade over approximately 5–30 ms without hard clicks
CMakeLists.txt lists CrossoverSplitter.cpp, MultibandGate.cpp, and HissCurtain.cpp
CMakeLists.txt registers tests/MultibandGateTests.cpp on the test target
No heap allocation introduced on the audio path after prepareToPlay
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: add member instances and includes for phase F DSP units on PluginProcessor
implement 5–30 ms equal-power or linear topology crossfade with preallocated dry/wet buffers
read existing APVTS parameters by ParameterIDs when available, else temporary defaults
add CMake target_sources entries for phase F DSP units and MultibandGateTests
derive MultibandGate targets from existing broadband gate gain plus per-band offsets when full per-band detectors are not yet present
forbidden: reimplement LR4, MultibandGate smoothing math, or TPT curtain math inside PluginProcessor
expand scope into Performance Timeline GUI or rejected-signal audition UI
